steps.action: Navigate to /trips and wait for initial Firestore trip fetch to settle
steps.expected: A meaningful empty state is shown when there are no trips
steps.observed: Page rendered "No trips yet. Sync with Strava to get started."

evidence.consoleErrors: No app-rendering error related to empty state (only environment extension noise: net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT)
evidence.network: Firestore Listen requests returned 200 while empty state rendered

Button changed to disabled "Syncing..." with animated refresh icon

steps.observed: Trip detail route renders only "Trip Detail Placeholder"; no map or photo upload/download flows and no corresponding loading states

assertions.issues: Blocked by prerequisite sync persistence failure; no trip cards were available to validate name/date/activity-count rendering.

frictions.description: Browser environment emitted extension-related net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT entries, adding noise while validating app-level errors and request outcomes.
frictions.resolution: Filtered evidence to localhost and app-origin requests plus explicit /api/strava/sync and curl outputs.

frictions.description: Sync failure opened a blocking browser alert dialog ("Failed to sync with Strava") before additional interactions were possible.
frictions.resolution: Accepted dialog and continued evidence collection.

blockers.description: Strava sync endpoint consistently failed: POST http://localhost:5001/api/strava/sync returned 500 with response {"status":"partial_success_or_error","activities_synced":64,"trips_created":64,"activities_saved":0,"activities_failed":64,"trips_saved":0,"trips_failed":64}.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Retried sync via UI and directly via curl; both attempts returned the same 500 result.

summary: Tested 7 assigned assertions: 1 passed, 2 failed, 4 blocked. Empty-state behavior passed; loading coverage and activity detail stats failed on current UI surface; sync-dependent assertions were blocked by repeatable /api/strava/sync 500 failures with zero persisted activities/trips.
